title: Reaction mechanism study of Al/Ti alloy thin films under thermal stimulation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6413-6423
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08413F, Paper
Open Access

Shimin Chang, Ruiqi Shen, Lizhi Wu
MD results show that larger modulation periods release more energy, while more cycles shorten reaction time and increase self-heating. In the “liquid-like” state (1840–1900 K), surface self-diffusion aids alloying.
